in_marathi.name: Saachi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Saachi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Saachi means 'the one who is the giver of grace and blessings from the Lord'. It is a name of Goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge, music, art, wisdom, and learning.
